subject: Follow-up on next week's visit
text:
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to follow up after our chat two days ago about the appointment. I think we’re all still happy with the Saturday morning slot, as long as the room is warm enough for the older folks who prefer the earlier time.

I’m okay bringing extra chairs, and I can arrive a little early to help with setup if needed. Please send a quick note if anything has changed or if someone needs a different time.

Thanks again for checking in with each other so quickly. I’m glad we could settle this before the week gets busier.
